tools.description: Given a support product code (from support_search) or a shop platform code (from search_products, lowercased), list the owner's manual, setup guide, statements and release notes. Then call manual_chapter with the book_id and a guid. An unknown product code is not_found.

After support_documents gave you a book_id and a guid, read a chapter; use the returned toc to find the guid of 'Keyboard', 'External ports and slots', 'Power adapter' or any other specification chapter. A guid the book does not contain is not_found.

Read component materials and care instructions of an IKEA product in any IKEA market on www.ikea.com (/{country}/{language}/ storefronts such as /us/en/, /gb/en/, /de/de/, /ae/ar/ or /jp/ja/), in the storefront's language.
